adminNote: The multisig behind a timelock that holds admin on NodeStake, ReleaseRegistry, EpochAnchor and ERC6699Registry. null = the deployer wallet, an EOA — the deploy tool warns and /health says admin: eoa (BUILD-SPEC v0.3 §2.3).

NodeStake.minStakeHuman: 1 tLITVM — proof-of-mechanism minimum; raise before any real operator onboarding
NodeStake.lockTermHuman: 10 minutes — unstake() is refused before the bond is this old. Proposed mainnet: 30 days
NodeStake.eligibilityAgeHuman: 2 minutes — a bond younger than this can host casual but cannot be drawn to attest. Proposed mainnet: 7 days
NodeStake.unbondingPeriodHuman: 60 minutes — must exceed MatchBook.totalWindow() (2640 s at the testnet windows); the deploy tool refuses otherwise. Proposed mainnet: 14 days
NodeStake.slasher: REMOVED in v3 — slash() is callable only by adjudicator contracts named by admin

ReleaseRegistry.activationDelayHuman: 60 seconds between register() and the earliest activatesAt. Proposed mainnet: 24 hours

TitleRegistry.activationDelayHuman: 60 seconds between setBuild() and the earliest activatesAt for a RETUNE; a title's first build is active at once. No admin: the token holder is the publisher. Proposed mainnet: 24 hours

MatchBook.status: written, compile-tested, behaviour-tested in-process (demo/matchbook-vm.test.mjs); not deployed
MatchBook.slashHuman: host 10% of its bond when the escalation panel rejects its result; a panel key 5% when it voted against the majority
MatchBook.note: NodeStake.unbondingPeriod must exceed MatchBook.totalWindow() = settle + 2×attest + 2×escalation = 2640 s at these values; the deploy tool and tools/params.mjs refuse otherwise
MatchBook.settleWindowHuman: 30 minutes from commit (placement) to settle: a human Agent Fighter match lasts minutes; the first ranked match on 21 Sep 2026 met a 60 s window

note: Testnet-only values. One faucet pull (1000 tLITVM) funds 1000 node bonds at this minimum.
